overview: Two-branch protocol with a shared outcome: branch A, a register-based follow-up of all grade 7 to 9 students if student-level access is granted; branch B, a two-stage cluster coverage survey with vaccination card checks if it is refused. Only one branch will run.
population: Students enrolled in grades 7 to 9 in the 41 district secondary schools during the 2025 to 2026 school year.
exposure: School neighbourhood deprivation quintile and school-level share of families speaking another language at home.
procedures: Branch A: extract register records with school and home postcode, apply the documented correction for doses given outside schools, and validate 300 records against vaccination cards. Branch B: sample 24 schools with probability proportional to size and 30 students per school, check vaccination cards at school with parental permission, and use parent report only when no card exists. Both branches count consent forms sent, returned and refused by school and delivery route.

outcomes.name: Up to date for all three adolescent vaccines
outcomes.measure: Proportion of students with a complete HPV series, meningococcal ACWY and the pertussis-containing booster
outcomes.why: The protection the campaign aimed to restore.

outcomes.name: Coverage of each vaccine
outcomes.measure: Proportion up to date for each vaccine separately

outcomes.name: Consent form return
outcomes.measure: Forms returned (signed or refused) divided by forms sent, by school and route
outcomes.why: The main reason for missed doses elsewhere.

outcomes.name: Status not determinable
outcomes.measure: Proportion of sampled or registered students whose status cannot be established
outcomes.why: Shows how much the estimate rests on assumptions.

feasibility: Branch A needs about 25 epidemiologist days; branch B about 40 days plus nurse time for card checks during school hours, within the two days a week available until June 2027.
biasMitigation: Register correction for doses given outside schools
Card checks rather than parent report in the survey

biasFlags.label: Register undercount
biasFlags.note: Branch A only; corrected and validated.

biasFlags.label: Survey non-response
biasFlags.note: Branch B only; families who do not return cards may be less vaccinated.

biasFlags.label: Ecological stratifiers
biasFlags.note: Deprivation and language are school or area measures.

flags: Two branches drafted, one will run
parsimony.simplestPath: Whichever data source is available, one outcome and two stratifiers.

theoreticalFramework: None; a descriptive coverage question does not need one.
summary: Two-branch protocol with one shared primary outcome; the branch is chosen by the data-access decision.
